review_candidates.title: Production manager
review_candidates.description: Department: Administration Location: Zurich Description As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry. Join the team and support us on our mission. THE POSITION These are your key tasks: In-House printing production Run and schedule the in-house print facility (digital and large-format printing, finishing, binding) to meet deadlines. Maintain equipment and consumables, and set quality standards for all finished output. Handle urgent, last-minute print requests for events, often same-day. Track costs and turnaround time, and uphold health and safety standards in the print area. Merchandise order coordination Create and deliver on-brand print and digital assets, from concept to final production. Support events, campaigns, and internal communications with high-quality creative solutions. Corporate internal online shop (External Partner Management) Act as main point of contact for the vendor operating the corporate online shop. Brief new products, manage the catalogue, and approve artwork before launch. Monitor service levels and fulfilment, and run regular performance reviews with the vendor. Graphic design Create on-brand print and digital assets. Prepare and review production-ready artwork. Deliver design solutions for events, campaigns, and internal communications. General Manage supplier relationships and support contract discussions. Track production status, costs, and performance metrics. Resolve operational issues and support junior team members or freelancers. Provide support during major events, including outside standard working hours. YOUR PROFILE We work hard at FIFA. We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative. And we respect our values. Always. For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset. The specific competencies we require for this position are: 3-5 years of experience in print production and graphic design. Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments. Experience managing external suppliers or agencies. Experience in sport, events, entertainment, or similar industries is an asset. Native/Fluent in English Working proficiency in German Professional-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) or equivalent design tools. Hands-on experience operating and maintaining print production equipment. Familiarity with e-commerce or online shop administration platforms is a plus. Bachelor's degree or equivalent vocational qualification in graphic design, print media, production, or a related field. Highly organised, able to work autonomously across multiple concurrent orders and deadlines. Commercially aware, with sound judgement on cost and quality trade-offs. Clear, confident communicator, comfortable briefing designers, suppliers and senior stakeholders. Calm under pressure, hands-on and detail-oriented. Thrives under tight, last-minute deadlines; reprioritizes quickly when urgent requests arise. Flexible and available to support events outside standard hours when required. Collaborative team player who takes ownership and follows through. PERKS & BENEFITS The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters. Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits: Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym. Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all. Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth. Continuous learning : We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it. Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions. Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation. Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport. Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance. Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

review_candidates.title: Paid Social Executive – Performance Marketing
review_candidates.description: We're looking for a Paid Social Executive with strong hands-on experience in performance marketing and customer acquisition . You will manage paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and X, with a strong focus on mobile app acquisition, conversion optimization and measurable business results . Reporting remotely to the Senior Digital Marketing Manager , you will be responsible for campaign setup and management, daily optimization, performance analysis, creative testing, tracking, and reporting across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X, and other relevant social platforms . You will play a key role in driving customer acquisition and growth , from app installs through registration, first deposit, and first trade. Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, X , and other relevant platforms. Manage campaigns across the full acquisition funnel, from awareness and app installs to registration, first deposit, and first trade . Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets, bids, audiences, placements, and creatives against agreed KPIs. Manage and allocate media budgets effectively, identifying opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns and improve acquisition efficiency. Develop structured creative testing plans and work closely with Content and Design teams to improve creative performance. Analyze campaign and funnel performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for campaign and creative optimization. Prepare clear weekly, monthly, and campaign-level performance reports . Monitor key performance metrics including CPA, CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, ROAS, acquisition cost, and revenue-related KPIs . Validate campaign tracking and event delivery across advertising platforms, AppsFlyer , and internal reporting systems. Support the testing and implementation of SDK events, pixels, Conversion APIs, deep links, UTM parameters, and attribution setups . Identify and investigate tracking or attribution discrepancies and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them. Work closely with Marketing, Creative, Product, Analytics, and Technology teams, as well as platform representatives and external partners. Stay up to date with changes in advertising platforms, paid media trends, competitor activity, and financial-services advertising policies . The Successful Applicant 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Paid Social, Performance Marketing, Paid Media, or Digital Advertising. Proven hands-on experience managing campaigns through Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads Manager, and X Ads . Professional fluency in English and Arabic is required. Strong understanding of mobile app acquisition, attribution, conversion funnels, and post-install events . Experience with AppsFlyer or another Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) is strongly preferred. Experience managing meaningful media budgets and optimizing campaigns against acquisition, conversion, and revenue-related objectives . Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate campaign data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, campaign structure, creative testing, and performance optimization . Excellent attention to detail, particularly in campaign setup, budget management, tracking, and reporting. Working knowledge of pixels, mobile SDKs, Conversion APIs, deep links, UTM parameters, and event tracking . Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with remote, cross-functional teams . Experience working with creative teams and translating performance insights into effective creative briefs and testing plans . Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets . Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualization tools is an advantage. Experience in fintech, financial services, trading, investing, e-commerce, mobile apps, or another performance-driven or regulated industry is an advantage. Google Ads experience is an advantage but not essential. What We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable working directly in advertising platforms . You should be someone who doesn't simply launch campaigns and report on results, but actively looks at the data, identifies what is working and what isn't, tests new approaches, and takes action to improve performance. If you enjoy paid acquisition, experimentation, numbers, and turning campaign data into growth , we'd love to hear from you.
